Deel pricing in 2026

Deel HR is now a paid three-tier ladder: Core $5, Advanced $19 and Elite $29 per employee per month. EOR sits at $599 per EOR employee per month and US PEO at $125 per US PEO employee per month. Contractor management is $49 per contractor per month, with Contractor of Record at $325. Deel Payroll Global is published at $29 per employee per month.

Published rates and provenance

Recent changesRe-verified 2026-09-22. The free Deel HR tier is gone: the pricing page publishes no free plan at any seat count. Deel HR is now a three-tier paid ladder under the Manage tab at $5 (Core), $19 (Advanced) and $29 (Elite) per employee per month. EOR holds at $599 per EOR employee per month and contractor management at $49 per contractor per month.

What the buying committee actually pays

Deel HR is now priced as a real HRIS ladder rather than a give-away wedge. Core covers worker profiles, org chart, roles, time off, time and attendance; Advanced adds performance and LMS; Elite adds compensation and headcount planning. One caveat for US PEO buyers: Deel's own pricing page carries two different US PEO figures, $125 per US PEO employee per month on the Hire tab and PEO Starter $110 / PEO Pro $120 per employee per month on the Pay tab, with Starter excluding PEO-sponsored health benefits. Confirm which SKU a quote is priced against. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

Is there still a free Deel HR tier?

No. The pricing page publishes no free plan at any seat count. Deel HR now starts at Core, $5 per employee per month, under the Manage tab. If you are working from a figure that says Deel HR is free up to 200 employees, that figure is retired.

What sits at each Deel HR tier?

Core at $5 covers worker profiles, org chart, roles and permissions, time off, time and attendance, job architecture, global compliance and AI reporting. Advanced at $19 adds performance reviews, goals and OKRs, LMS, career frameworks, engagement surveys and recognition. Elite at $29 adds pay bands, compensation cycles, total rewards, headcount planning and cost forecasting.

How much does Deel EOR cost per employee?

$599 per EOR employee per month, published as a flat figure on the Hire tab. The pricing page does not publish a per-country uplift table, so country-specific pricing is a quote question rather than a listed rate.

What does Deel US PEO cost?

Check which figure your quote is priced against, because Deel publishes two. The Hire tab shows $125 per US PEO employee per month. The Pay tab shows PEO Starter at $110 and PEO Pro at $120 per employee per month, and notes that Starter does not include PEO-sponsored health benefits. Deel is also running a promotion of three months of free platform fees on PEO order forms signed between 15 July and 31 December 2026, on a minimum two-year term, with the credit applied at the end of the initial term.

What does Deel Payroll cost?

Deel Payroll Global is published at $29 per employee per month. Deel Payroll US is an add-on at $29 per employee per month self-service. Benefits Management Global and Treasury are $10 per employee per month each, and Payroll Connect is $5 per employee per month.

How does Deel price contractor management?

$49 per contractor per month for contractor management, covering centralised contractor records, payments in 120+ currencies, automated invoicing, tax form guidance and classification compliance. Contractor of Record, where Deel takes on the classification liability, is $325 per contractor per month.

When does Deel beat Rippling for a global team?

When EOR is the dominant cost line. Deel EOR is the most-deployed EOR product on the market in 2026 and frequently undercuts Rippling Global on per-country fees.
